scope: Recolor all visible established turf while retaining original texture, luminance, debris and non-turf features.
eligibleMaterials: established dormant turf with visible retained blade texture
blockedMaterialsAndDependencies: sparse or missing turf requiring new texture
debris or foliage too fine/dense for reliable 2048x1024 source-mask protection
visible or possible turf reflection requiring optical editing
requested parcel subset without verified source support
insufficient original context after the bounded follow-up
workflow: Verify owned native bytes and original preparation.
Run typed source-only admissibility on the original 2K panorama and six original directions.
When a resolvable original boundary remains uncertain, extract at most two exact native detail views and run one follow-up carrying the prior findings.
Only an eligible source proceeds to the existing scene plan and one image.
Retain the existing post-image material/color-guidance assessment, source-role segmentation, native chroma composition and independent full-sphere checks.

budget.credentialFallback: Only explicit exhausted-quota response; fresh authority and cancellation check before each attempt.

validation: Pending exact-tree pinned Linux integration and independent review. Synthetic tests do not establish fresh-scene quality.
